# VangaTypePanalam
> Free typing practice app supporting English, Tamil & Tanglish

## Description
VangaTypePanalam is a free, adaptive typing practice app that works offline. Learn touch typing from scratch with progressive lessons, per-key tracking, and real-time feedback. Supports English (QWERTY), Tamil (Tamil99), and Tanglish typing.

## Features
- Adaptive typing practice with real-time feedback
- 30 progressive touch typing lessons
- WPM speed test (15s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s)
- Ghost racing mode against AI bots
- Per-key accuracy tracking and heatmaps
- Weekly book practice with custom content
- Detailed stats, achievements, and badges
- Season challenges and gamification
- Offline-capable (IndexedDB-based)
- Free, no account required for basic use

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 with App Router
- TypeScript
- PostgreSQL (Neon) with Prisma ORM
- IndexedDB for offline storage
- Auth.js (NextAuth) for authentication
- Zustand for state management
- Deployed on Vercel

## Languages Supported
- English (en)
- Tamil (ta) — Tamil99 keyboard layout
- Tanglish (ta+en)
